text:
frank: Ok team, one-thread for landing copy + microtests + webinar gating. Need headlines, 2 CTAs per mode, benchmark blurbs for sidebar card, and exact hidden fields for routing. Goal: ship to staging tonight.
jaya: I'll do H1/H2 for all three modes with two tonal variants each (metric vs. human outcome). Posting in a minute.
li: small ask: include the exact checkbox copy we should show on the form and the privacy line.
nate: routing ops: propose hidden fields: lead_mode, campaign_source, consult_consent. Mapping: lead_mode=hosted -> hosted_trial queue; lead_mode in (dedicated,private) -> enterprise_sales queue. If consult_consent=true -> tag=needs_consult. Also add utm_source=organic_launch for social.
marta: benchmark blurbs: latency case: "Median tail 28ms (seq512) on prod config"; embeddings: "2.7x throughput vs baseline"; compliance: "audit logs + KMS validated". Will add a 1-line methodology anchor.
jaya: DRAFT HEROS:
HOSTED - Metric: H1: "3x faster time-to-serve for production prompts." H2: "Hosted API: instant onboarding, stable latency." CTA primary: "Start Hosted"; micro-CTA: "Download benchmark"
HOSTED - Human: H1: "Ship features, not ops." H2: "Hosted API with SDKs & streaming." CTA primary: "Start Hosted"; micro-CTA: "See results"
DEDICATED - Metric: H1: "Dedicated throughput, predictable cost." H2: "Reserved GPU pools and SLA controls." CTA primary: "Reserve Dedicated"; micro-CTA: "Request benchmarks"
DEDICATED - Human: H1: "Capacity you can count on." H2: "Isolation + commit pricing." CTA primary: "Reserve Dedicated"; micro-CTA: "Talk capacity"
PRIVATE - Metric: H1: "On-prem latency with cloud convenience." H2: "VPC, KMS, and audit-grade controls." CTA primary: "Request Demo"; micro-CTA: "Compliance brief"
PRIVATE - Human: H1: "Inference inside your walls." H2: "Full control, strong guarantees." CTA primary: "Request Demo"; micro-CTA: "Speak to an engineer"
li: checkbox + privacy copy:
Checkbox: "Yes, Id like a capacity consult and agree to be contacted."
Privacy line: "We use your info to follow up about this request. See our privacy policy."
nate: form webhook snippet for eng:
POST /api/lead
payload: { name, email, company, lead_mode, consult_consent, est_monthly_tokens, utm_campaign }
routing rules: if lead_mode == "hosted" -> queue=hosted_trial; else -> queue=enterprise_sales; if consult_consent == true -> add_tag=needs_consult
marta: social + webinar gating idea: gate the full benchmark PDF behind registration for the webinar. Everyone who downloads is auto-tagged consult_lead if they checked the box. Webinar benefit line: "See real configs that reduced unit cost without raising tail latency." Takeaways bullets: architecture patterns; batching & cache tips; rollout & fallback.
jaya: A/B plan: Variant A uses metric-led hero on homepage; Variant B uses human-outcome heroes. Measure week 1: form CTR, week 2: consult checkbox rate. Secondary: webinar signups.
frank: timeline: jaya push copy to staging by 16:00, li confirm microcopy and privacy by 17:00, nate wire hooks and SFDC queues by 18:00, marta finalize benchmark PDF by tomorrow morning. Leave deploy-bot hold until I sign off.
deploy-bot: pages-deploy: staging deploy scheduled 2026-06-09T18:00Z; social-scheduler queued 2026-06-10T09:00 UTC; status: on_hold.
